maya_csm: FYI flagged via health scan: CarouselTech showing churn risk. Activation plateau after initial pilot week.
tom_ae: Renewal in 46 days, agreed POC for analytics team. Do we have telemetry on embedding calls?
maya_csm: embeddings usage fell to 20% of expected; stream sessions abandoned mid-demo twice. Logged errors around 2024-07-12.
jess_onboard: They said prompt templates feel brittle and KV lookups inconsistent with docs. Offered a follow-up but low engagement.
nate_support: There were transient routing mismatches between region eu-west and eu-central; ticket INF-4987 closed but they saw it live.
maya_csm: Proposed micro-save: 1) 30-min "stabilize & train" workshop + tailored snippet pack, 2) one-time 45% usage credit for two weeks to re-run demos, 3) safe downgrade export + read-only report, 4) internal RCA + mitigation notes sent to technical stakeholders.
tom_ae: I'll join with a short ROI slide. Schedule within 72h?
jess_onboard: I can do a hands-on lab showing prompt routing fixes and sample mapping scripts. Will prepare `FixList.md` with steps: set routing header, enable client-side backoff, validate KV index.
infra_bot: Created task CS-SAVE-872 for CarouselTech.
nate_support: Recommend fallback routing to regional replica and a smaller model variant (gpt-small) while we stabilize. Also propose to enable request-level logging for 14 days.
maya_csm: Outreach draft: SUBJECT: Quick reschedule + credits to re-run your POC BODY: ```Hi <Name>,
We noticed the pilot stalled. Can we grab 30 mins to help re-run the demo and provide credits to cover it? We'll also share export options if you need to downgrade.
Book: <cal_link>
Thanks, Maya```
tom_ae: Add a line offering a short exec touchpoint to reset expectations.
jess_onboard: Post-call: 3-question pulse survey and tag ticket in Gainsight. Capture action items in CS-SAVE-872.
maya_csm: I'll own follow-ups and capture the export snapshot. Nate, please compile the mitigation note. Keep thread limited to blockers.
infra_bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 48h for CS-SAVE-872.
